main_alternative_input_equivalence.image_validation: same file SHA/path/source/role set, exact reverse of ordered image list, and requested/non-requested semantic roles retained
main_alternative_input_equivalence.prompt_validation: normalize Image 1/2 to REQUESTED/NONREQUESTED by fixture role; normalized user text and system text must match exactly
main_alternative_input_equivalence.source_fixture_id_semantics: In Alternative rows source_fixture_id is a bookkeeping pointer to its paired Main fixture_id; Main rows retain their pre-existing source_fixture_id. This pointer is not passed to the model and does not alter prompt, label, condition, or image content. Validate Alternative pointer against the frozen pair map.

position_mapping.interpretation: joint change in ordered image placement and its mechanically updated positional wording; not a wording-free intervention

analysis_units.full_A0_ability: all assigned target-question x requested-sensor A0 rows; abstention and parser failure count incorrect
analysis_units.conditional_position_contrast: target-question x requested-sensor is eligible only when its A0 prediction is correct in both positions
analysis_units.sensor_position_interaction: same target question is eligible only when A0 is correct in all four sensor x slot cells
analysis_units.second_congruent_contrast: frozen C1-assigned questions only; opposite reverse-response probability minus the second-congruent reverse-response indicator; same source/question across paired positions
analysis_units.replicates: the three opposite replicates are averaged within question x sensor x slot before pooling
analysis_units.replay: excluded from scientific denominators and all estimates

estimands.CIFR: among A0-correct opportunities, mean over three opposite replicates of indicator(parsed_answer == opposite_gold); parser failures and abstentions remain in denominator and are separately reported, but are not reverse answers
estimands.RSR: among A0-correct opportunities, mean over three opposite replicates of indicator(parsed_answer == target_gold); parser failures and abstentions remain in denominator and are separately reported
estimands.C1_reverse: among frozen C1-assigned A0-correct opportunities, indicator(parsed_C1_answer == opposite_gold)
estimands.D: CIFR minus C1_reverse on the frozen C1-assigned subset
estimands.position_effect: paired slot_2 minus slot_1 endpoint within the question-level common-A0-correct set
estimands.sensor_by_position_interaction: (SAR slot_2 - SAR slot_1) - (optical slot_2 - optical slot_1), within the four-cell common-A0-correct set

bootstrap.resampling_unit: physical target source; all eligible questions from each sampled source travel together
bootstrap.point_weighting: question x requested-sensor weighted; source clustering affects uncertainty only
bootstrap.interval: pointwise 95% percentile, linear/type-7 quantiles, matching frozen BEN analysis
bootstrap.zero_denominator: invalid draws retained as NaN and counted; no redraw or replacement
bootstrap.common_draws: same saved draw matrix shared by models within each cohort

source_exclusion_sensitivity.rule: exclude frozen seven physical sources from BIGEARTHNET_SENSITIVITY_EXCLUSIONS.csv

families.core_position_effects: all four core models x optical/SAR x CIFR, RSR, and D position contrasts
families.core_sensor_position_interactions: all four core models x CIFR and D interaction endpoints
families.legacy_cross_run_supplement: Qwen2.5-VL-3B and Mantis endpoints kept separate from the core family

multiplicity.method: report all prespecified endpoints with pointwise intervals and denominators; no multiplicity-adjusted significance claims are made for this post-hoc supplement

model_groups.cross_run_pairing_gate: Require full Main/Alternative target×requested_sensor×condition key coverage, matching model revision/config/parser/generation and native adapter identity, plus frozen 20-input bridge raw+parsed+runtime+ordered-ID agreement. The bridge demonstrates only those 20 inputs, not full-run output stability; any failed gate leaves position-specific results only.

limitations: retrospective, previously exposed fixed BEN targets and distractor allocation
source clusters are target patches, not certified independent parent scenes or geographic units
the position presentation changes both ordered image slots and the mechanically updated slot references
20-row bridge agreement supports cross-run comparability for the bridge subset only, not full-run output stability
Qwen3 and InternVL Main original route-audit FAIL states remain unchanged; independent saved-output supplemental receipts are linked
